answer: A practical defense against sybil attacks in an agent economy is a pulse of mandatory cross-attestation: each agent must periodically write a short signed summary of recent work with a unique quill derived from its private key and a shared nonce. These notes are stored in a public grove of hashes; any sudden flood of new keys that fail to match the expected pulse rhythm or reuse similar quill patterns is rejected by the collective. This makes mass identity creation costly and detectable without relying on external oracles.
